liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1983-10-31.sbd.clugston.3811.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min; rated 3.2/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd83-10-31.sbd.gardner.3827.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 158 min; rated 4/5 by 20 [2]. Said about its sound: The sound quality is noted as much above average with a great groove; The opening song sounds slightly off, though the audio improves as the show progresses; The recording is sped up, making the song 5:06 instead of the actual 7:06 [14][16][18]
- **gd1983-10-31.sbd.tetzeli.34934.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 158 min; rated 1.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1983-10-31.151222.sbd.mc.gems.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 159 min [4]. Said about its sound: Nak700 audience source is used for the first few minutes of Wang Dang Doodle [4]
- **gd83-10-31.horvath-nak.ladner.19894.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 160 min; rated 4.46/5 by 28 [8]. Said about its sound: The audio is significantly sped up, with Wang Dang Doodle lasting 5:06 instead of 7:06; The keys sound like chimes, contributing to an amazing overall recording quality [19][20]

## Around the show

- Airto joined drummers, prompting Jerry to jam behind them during Halloween chants [9]
- This was the final live performance of St. Stephen, played to a small crowd [11]
- The venue was described as a small location in the band's backyard [11]
- A weird sound in the first minute of Peggy-O was heard by both fans and recording [4]
- The first set Sailor/Saint sequence was highlighted as a real treat [9]
- The Airto drums-space jam is ranked among the best improvisational performances [10]
- This is the last live performance of St. Stephen, following a 352-show hiatus [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-10-31.sbd.clugston.3811.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Cassette > DAT > CDR [1]
- **gd83-10-31.sbd.gardner.3827.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> MC> DAT> CDR> EAC> CDWAV> SHN [2]. Also: SBD transferred via MC, DAT, CDR, EAC, CDWAV, SHN; via Tony Gardner, thanks to Paul Bottiglio [2]
- **gd1983-10-31.sbd.tetzeli.34934.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Soundboard > Cassette [3]. Also: Transition between CDs 2 and 3 was made seamless with fade tracks added [3]
- **gd1983-10-31.151222.sbd.mc.gems.flac16**: taped by Provided by ANON; transferred by Speed Corrected by Jason Chastain Mastered by Jamie Waddell with assistance from Jim Blackwood Track FLAC and Pack by Mark Goldey; source: Soundboard Cassette Master > DAT [4]
- **gd83-10-31.horvath-nak.ladner.19894.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB(Nak 700)>MC>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN. [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Marin County Veterans Auditorium - October 31, 1983](https://www.dead.net/show/october-31-1983) [22]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Ticket, Marin Veterans Memorial Auditorium, San Rafael, CA](https://www.dead.net/archives/1983/clippings/ticket-marin-veterans-memorial-auditorium-san-rafael-ca-0) [23]
